source_excerpt:
See who Power Dental Studio has hired for this role
Company Profile: Power Dental Studio Milling is a full-service state-of-the-art dental laboratory specializing in the manufacture of a wide variety of dental oral prosthetics, such as CAD/CAM restorations, fixed and removable implant cases, flexible partials, full and partial dentures and much, much more. Our beautiful ultra-modern lab boasts all of the best equipment, rockstar employees & a team-centred culture. We need an experience dental digital designer to be a part of this team
Job Title - Digital Dental Design Technician
Industry - Medical Devices/ Dentistry/Healthcare/CAD-CAM Designer
· Our lab technicians need to be trained and have experience with digital photography and computer-aided aesthetic matching to ensure a natural appearance for restorations.
· On the job training opportunities to improve designing skills
· In this role you should be able to design dental CAD framework, full contour crowns, bridges, implant abutments, veneers, diagnostic wax ups and implants, using EXOCAD software CAD /CAM and milling technology.
· Read, interpret and design dental restorations to client's specifications by using Exocad / 3Shape a dental CAD software program
· Proficient in dental anatomy and terminology
· Minimum of 2 years dental laboratory experience as a dental designer, prior experience working in design for a dental implant manufacturer, or CAD / CAM designer
· Experience with 3shape, Exocad, and other desktop scanners and software required
· Course/Certification is CAD/CAM required
Industries Medical Equipment Manufacturing
